title: Tough, Balanced and Inverted stay on in an interaction with a Pure card, against Pure's printed "ignore all other attributes"
summary: The owner ruling of 2026-09-05 (“{Pure} outside combat: the same switch…”) (and the owner ruling of 2026-08-20 (“{Pure}: the attribute layer, switched off…”), as the owner ruling of 2026-09-05 (“{Pure} outside combat: the same switch…”) reads it) keep the stat attributes Tough, Balanced and Inverted applying in a Pure pairing because "they are stat layers". Pure's printed reminder ignores all other attributes, and the Manual lists Tough as an attribute. Under the authority order the printed text wins (rule attr.general.pure; D-U19-2). Suspected engine behaviour: a Pure blocker facing a Tough unit is priced against the doubled defense. Measured by the round-1 verifier: a Pure source dealing 5 to Rampart Guardian leaves it alive as a Tough 0/8. Measured by the round-2 verifier: a Balanced 4/1 dealt 3 by a Pure source survives as a 4/4. (Measured by a verifier probe; the probe files are not committed.)

evidence.quote: {Tough}, {Balanced} and {Inverted} still read (they are stat layers, R61).
Pure cards and cards they are interacting with ignore all other attributes.
CR 802.25e / CT-260: a Pure source dealing 5 to Rampart Guardian kills it, because its Tough is off in the pairing

closed: fixed on 2026-10-22 (CT-260; the owner followed print): in a Pure interaction Tough, Balanced, Inverted and Unaware do not apply (555).

title: The combat Unaware collapse is said to survive Pure, while noncombat Pure switches Unaware off
summary: The owner ruling of 2026-08-23 (“STAT LAYER 6, {Unaware}: everything in…”) says the Unaware collapse of a combat exchange "survives {Pure}", because Unaware is a stat layer. The owner ruling of 2026-09-05 (“{Pure} outside combat: the same switch…”) switches a Pure pairing's Unaware off outside combat, and Pure's printed reminder ignores all other attributes. The engine therefore appears to treat Unaware + Pure differently in combat and outside it, and the combat half contradicts the printed text (rule attr.general.pure; D-U19-2).

title: Oorblak's combat-damage redirect doubles damage onto a Pure Vulnerable Oorblak
summary: The pilot's round-2 probe (P5) gave Oorblak Pure and Vulnerable and redirected a non-Pure 3-power unblocked column into it: Oorblak was dealt 6 and died. The owner ruling of 2026-08-20 (“{Pure}: the attribute layer, switched off…”) and the owner ruling of 2026-09-05 (“{Pure} outside combat: the same switch…”) say a Pure recipient's own Vulnerable is off. The redirect is a damage commit in card code (the owner ruling of 2026-08-28 (“{Deadly} reaches every damage site, and…”) calls it "the fourth site") and appears not to read Pure. Exotic but reachable (Just a Unit is a Virus).

title: The engine balances a printed-Balanced unit before doubling an augment's Tough, against Manual p.42
summary: Manual p.42: Tough augmented onto a Balanced unit has its defense doubled, then its stats balanced. The engine follows the owner ruling of 2026-08-18 (“Stat layer 4 application order”)’s engine call (own printed attributes first, then augment-granted ones), so it balances first. Measured by the round-1 verifier: Child of Aether (printed Balanced, 2/0) augmented with Rampart Guardian (Tough) is a 2/4; the Manual makes it a 2/2. The owner ruling of 2026-08-18 (“Stat layer 4 application order”)’s premise that the Manual does not specify printed-vs-granted order is wrong for this pair. No test guards the printed-host case (rule attr.general.application-order; D-U19-1). (Measured by a verifier probe; the probe files are not committed.)

title: The engine inverts from a rewritten base, not from the printed stats
summary: The rule (the designer, 2023 and 2025) has Inverted invert the difference between a unit's printed stats and its current stats, a base rewrite included. The engine's layer 5 reflects the stats around the layer-2 base (p = 2 * base - p), so a base rewrite is never inverted: a printed 7/5 made base 3/3 by Aberrant Statweaver stays 3/3 when Inverted, where the rule makes it 11/7. 79-round17-layers pins the engine's reading.
